assets.name: west-shoulder
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one isolated distant Jiangnan mountain ridge asset for a painterly 3D farming game. Input 1 is approved material style: selective fine moss/tea-grey contours, layered pale colour washes, broad matte forms. Input 2 is approved world mood only; do NOT reproduce its village, farm, UI, clouds or composition. Subject: one long asymmetric low blue-green ridge, a rounded high shoulder on the LEFT, three smaller descending saddles toward the right, connected naturally, quiet southern Chinese wooded hills, not karst needles or snowy Alps. Front elevation from across a lake, no visible overhead ground plane. Pale slate/celadon pigment, subtle readable rock folds and clustered tree brush shapes, gentle neutral diffuse illumination without baked sunset. This is an independent far-mountain silhouette for angular sky compositing; not a complete landscape. COMPLETE silhouette and base inside frame, hills taper down to low ends with transparent margin on all four sides. Wide 3:1 canvas. TRUE RGBA transparent background including the sky and all space outside the mountain. No white or beige paper rectangle, no checkerboard, no water, reflections, fog clouds, village, pagoda, text, frame or contact shadow. The lower foothill contour should remain solid, alpha only soft at silhouette edge, do not wash the whole asset out.
assets.output:

The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
